what: A full-screen hero photo panel (pinned to the screen) is scrubbed to scroll (no curve). It starts when the top edge of the from slot hits 70% of the viewport and ends when the center of the to slot, a small slot left empty inside a large copy line, reaches screen center. By then it has shrunk to that slot’s size and position. Once shrunk it stays attached to the slot and scrolls up with the document. Scrolling back makes it grow to full screen again, so the hero photo settles in as one character of the next section’s copy

options.to: Slot to land in (CSS selector, anywhere in the document) — required
options.from: Box (CSS selector) that measures where the line starts — starts when its top edge reaches 70% of the screen. If none, when the attached panel reaches the top of the screen
options.[data-fx-part=media]: (If present) image · video that covers and fills the panel — img · video children are filled too

note: The attached panel must cover the screen with position: fixed (its position is moved with transform, width and height). Since the panel floats above other sections, the z-index is set by whoever uses it.
